punchline: MMA champion Frank Shamrock said every fighter needs three training partners: one better, one worse and one exactly as good.
thirty_sec: Ryan Holiday quotes Epictetus: you can't learn what you think you already know. Then he brings in fighter Frank Shamrock's system, plus, minus, equal. Train with someone better, so you stay humble. Teach someone less skilled, so you find out what you really understand. Spar with an equal, so you can't coast. Each role keeps ego from getting comfortable, which matters most right when you start to succeed.
question: Who's the person right now who's better than you at something you care about?
